svg.title: Inside the Night Shift — Kiro workflows in Cowboys vs. Wizards
svg.desc: Separate recorded Kiro workflows. The Cautious Sheriff and Reckless Wizard each wrote a playbook. The arena referee ran 16 games and verified a replay. Sheriff won 13, Wizard 3. Card Forge tested Dusty Pete in a sandbox. The balance reviewer passed a Billy proposal for human review. The later 100,000-duel audit is separate. The Outrider hook, installed Power, scheduled Night Watch, release review and independent Python audit are separate checks. Full text and records are linked beneath the diagram in the repository README.

g.text: Two agents each write one playbook. The referee runs them on the Showdown engine.
Drafts one card in a sandbox.
Tests both decks on the same deals.
Proposes one change to a troop.
Passes the edit or sends it back.
Passed review. Alex and Fable decide.
Run Node and Chrome, then verify the receipt.
Stop before any game checks run.
5,086 played positions matched in 100 frozen duels.
One ruling on empty-board Hellfire affects 39 alternate moves.
